item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The world of metals and non-metals
item.stem:
Sana uses a circuit tester with a cell, a bulb, and wires. She joins an iron nail between the free ends and the bulb glows. She then joins a plastic comb between the free ends and the bulb stays off. The tester wires have rubber covering.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: The iron nail is a good conductor; the plastic comb is a poor conductor.
options.B: The iron nail is a poor conductor because in another try the bulb stayed off when a tester wire was disconnected.
options.C: A glowing bulb means the joined material is a poor conductor.
options.D: The rubber covering on the tester wires is a good conductor because the bulb glows with the iron nail.
